_comment: Edit with switchboard.py (add/remove/list), or by hand. Prices are USD per 1M tokens, in/out, recorded when the entry was added — they drift, so treat them as ordering, not billing. 'good_at' is fed verbatim to the router model when Auto picks.
_picker_note: Two ways to shorten the /model menu. (1) 'picker' below drives gateway discovery: family rows collapse variants and pick a tier per task. (2) 'switchboard.py picker --apply' writes a modelPicker lineup into ~/.claude/settings.json with replaceBuiltInOptions, which replaces the WHOLE menu — so you can drop Claude rows you never use and list every variant explicitly instead. Either way, Auto still routes across the full 'models' list. The menu shows 10 rows before collapsing the rest behind '… +N models'.
_claude_rows_note: Used only by 'picker --apply'. These are the built-in Claude rows worth keeping when the lineup is replaced; drop or reorder freely. Aliases work ('sonnet', 'opus[1m]').
_apply_models_note: Used only by 'picker --apply': the exact gateway variants to list as their own rows. Anything omitted is still routable by Auto.

models.name: Claude Haiku
models.good_at: quick well-formed answers and light tool use, with no cash cost. Costs subscription quota.

models.name: Claude Sonnet
models.good_at: the reliable default for real coding and agentic tool use, with no cash cost. Costs subscription quota.

models.name: Claude Opus
models.good_at: hardest reasoning and large multi-file refactors, with no cash cost. Costs the most subscription quota.

models.name: DeepSeek Flash
models.good_at: bulk mechanical work at the lowest price available - renames, greps, reformatting, straightforward edits. 1M context.

models.name: DeepSeek Pro
models.good_at: hard reasoning and multi-step code work at mid price. Strong on maths and algorithms.

models.name: Google Gemini Flash
models.good_at: fast general work, summarising, multimodal input. A safe cheap default when unsure.

models.name: Google Gemini Pro
models.good_at: long documents, large codebases, careful analysis over very large context.

models.name: Qwen Flash
models.good_at: cheap agentic and coding work, visual understanding, long video and document analysis.

models.name: xAI Grok
models.good_at: current events, informal reasoning, code review with opinions.

models.name: Z.ai GLM
models.good_at: agentic tool use and coding at mid price.

models.name: Kimi K3
models.good_at: building user interfaces - React, CSS, layout, data visualisation, marketing pages
models.source: Arena WebDev #1 (1679) Jul 2026; Vercel Next.js eval tied #1 at 92%

models.name: OpenRouter Auto
models.good_at: ANY paid work with no specialist need. Delegates the choice: OpenRouter classifies the prompt into a task type and ranks models by community spend over 7 days, so it tracks the field without this catalog being maintained. Prefer it over naming a specific priced model unless that model has a SPECIALTY the task needs.
models.source: openrouter.ai auto router; ranks by trailing-7-day community task spend

_arrow_note: The ←/→ row. Claude Code's effort slider reaches the wire as output_config.effort, and a row declared via ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION with SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES=effort,xhigh_effort,max_effort gets that slider even as a gateway id. So one picker row carries this shortlist and the arrows choose between them. Ordered weakest to strongest; an unmapped level falls to the strongest set.
